metadata.title: Pop Star Dance Party Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, layered composition featuring a central pop star figure against a purple patterned background with bold, multi-colored horizontal text bands.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central female figure in a metallic gold jacket is framed by a purple background featuring faint, stylized floral line art. The composition is anchored by a large, stylized logo with marquee-light textures and two thick horizontal color bands (pink and lime green) containing bold sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered and overlapping the background patterns
Logo positioned over the subject's torso for depth
Horizontal color bands cutting across the lower third
High contrast between purple background and lime green banner
coreInvariants: Purple background with faint geometric floral line art
Metallic gold texture on the subject's clothing
Marquee-light or glitter fill within the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, slightly angled, occupying the top two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized logo with marquee-light texture in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the central logo, then across the horizontal color bands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Purple background areas around the subject filled with subtle line art patterns.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pink and Gold (upper banner and jacket)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value contrast between the banners and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Bold sans-serif and stylized display lettering
letterConstructionRules: Primary logo uses heavy, blocky forms with thick dark outlines
Secondary text uses clean, italicized sans-serif capitals
Internal fills include dot patterns mimicking marquee lights
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters are significantly larger and interlocking
Numerical characters are thick and rounded with heavy outlines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy stylized display type paired with clean, slanted geometric sans-serifs.

preserve: Italicized slant of the lower text
Thick outlines on the main logo

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and slant of the lower banner text.
Provides a similar heavy, playful display feel for the main logo skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a purple background with faint, large-scale floral line art patterns. Place a central figure of a smiling girl with blonde hair wearing a shiny gold metallic jacket.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, thick-outlined logo in the center with a marquee-dot fill. Below it, add two horizontal bands—one pink and one lime green—containing bold, italicized sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the background purple with subtle patterns?
Are there two distinct horizontal color bands at the bottom?
Does the main logo have a thick outline and internal dot texture?
Is the lower text italicized and bold?

adjustableVariables: Texture of the main logo fill

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector edges on text

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible against the color bands
Ensure the gold jacket has a metallic sheen
Verify the purple background patterns are subtle and not distracting
Confirm the logo outline is thick and consistent
recipe.reuseFormula: Central pop-star subject + purple patterned background + marquee-textured logo + dual-tone horizontal text banners.
